name: memova
description: Use Knowledge V5, run Memova workflows, and import selected content.

interface.shortDescription: Create reviewed Knowledge Entries and use Memova workflows.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Memova through OAuth MCP for bounded Knowledge V5 retrieval, reviewed first-class Knowledge Entry creation and revision, automation workflows, and selected-content import. An exact user-supplied Codex task URL authorizes reading only that task; the workflow locally filters it to user/assistant text and never lists tasks or runs in the background.
defaultPrompt: Search and use my Memova Knowledge V5.
Create or update a reviewed Knowledge Entry in Memova.
